context_for_next_testing_agent: Employer Pipeline View feature is complete and working. The employer@vhctalent.com user has a DISABLED team (VHC Talent Team), so their pipeline returns empty - this is expected behavior. To test with actual data, either enable the team or use a different employer. Stage transitions work via PUT /api/applications/{id} with {stage: 'new_stage'}. Add notes work via POST /api/applications/{id}/notes with {content: 'note text'}. Admin pipeline shows 29 applications. Recruiter pipeline uses applicationAPI.getAll() not a dedicated endpoint.
